about: K-E1.4 (P1-E.1/E1.4): FAILs that frozen recorders of earlier rounds record in every chain because of decisions taken after their round. A FAIL listed here is shown as historical (closed by its decisions) and not counted, only while its record equals the same record of the reference RUN (paths under `changes` may differ, each with its decision). Any other FAIL counts. research/eval/historical.py.

P1-C.1's recorder expects spec 1.0.2; the spec is 1.0.3
P1-C's hybrid multi-question nDCG@10 was -0.0136 off v2; closed in P1-C.1 by the declared lexical variant and the Rust quality reference
P1-C's regression against P1-B.1 sees B1-3's spec-version difference

P1-D's HTTP e2e expects spec 1.0.2 (D7-3) and the old status codes of two cases
P1-D's regression against P1-C.1 sees the lexical record (lexical.dl), the index manifest and the spec/fixture changes since
